import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

final exampleProvider = StateProvider<String>((ref) => '');

class FixtureWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  const FixtureWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    ref.read(exampleProvider.notifier).state = 'bad';

    return Container(
      color: Colors.white,
      child: Text(
        'Fixture',
        style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFFFFFF)),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class SecondFixtureWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const SecondFixtureWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    context.go('/bad-route');
    return const SizedBox.shrink();
  }
}
